newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares the same, U.S. to decide way ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares the same, U.S. to decide way ahead.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Monday after a dull day, with dealers seeing overnight trends in the United States determining the way the local market would go.

"It has been a exceedingly quiet Monday. It's up to Wall Street now to set the agenda. The U.S. market reaction to today's November NAPM data will colour market trends here tomorrow," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed a marginal 0.06 point up at 130.98 while the KFX December future rose 0.35 point to 131.30 with 128 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Among KFX stock, Danisco was the most traded paper with some 166,000 shares changing hands to close only one crown up, while Tele Danmark finished two crowns up in 117,00 turnover at 296.
SAS rose one crown to close at 73, while FLS ended the day seven percent or 50 crowns higher at 790 after CEO Birger Riisager forecast a bumper 1996 net profit for the group.
